crossRefs.note: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

translations.web: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
translations.bsb: Then I asked the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?”
translations.kjv: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left
translations.asv: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive-trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
